summary: Project Mars Architects is an innovative space-exploration initiative developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge, focusing on sustainable habitat construction on the Red Planet. Our project addresses the extreme environmental challenges of Mars by designing resilient, 3D-printed living structures utilizing local Martian resources. By combining advanced automated 3D-construction techniques with radiation-shielding materials, we developed a scalable and efficient housing solution to protect future astronauts. This project is crucial for paving the way for long-term human settlement on Mars, ensuring safety, structural integrity, and self-sufficiency in deep-space exploration.
details: Project Mars Architects is a Martian habitat solution that uses automated 3D-printing technologies to turn local regolith into sturdy building components. Designed to protect the crew from cosmic radiation and extreme temperatures, the project establishes a scalable foundation for permanent human settlement. Developed using advanced CAD software and material simulations, it creatively combines in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) with robotic construction to minimize heavy cargo transport from Earth.
